_readme: Fixed 9x4 frame. level 0-3 is a self-assessment; evidence_ids link to content/evidence. gap_plan is required for every cell rated 0 or 1.

dimensions.desc_en: Stand it up, debug it, explain failures
Define metrics, run controls, judge trust
dimensions.desc_zh: 定义指标、做对照、判断可信

levels.name_zh: 能 own 接口与取舍
能独立交付并解释失败

layers.one_en: Cameras, LiDAR, IMU, tactile, calibration, time sync
layers.one_zh: 相机/激光/IMU/触觉、标定、时间同步
layers.gap_plan: Build: bring up one new sensor end to end (driver, sync, calibration). Deploy: run a calibrated capture on a real cell.

layers.one_en: Mechanism, joints, drives, hands, end effectors
layers.one_zh: 机构、关节、驱动、灵巧手、末端
layers.gap_plan: Design: own a joint module selection with torque/speed budget. Build: assemble a hand on a real arm. Deploy: measure backlash and repeatability on hardware.
Deploy: run the servo stack on a physical arm with contact perturbations; compare against sim.

layers.one_en: Detection, segmentation, SLAM, 3D reconstruction, state estimation
layers.one_zh: 检测分割、SLAM、3D 重建、状态估计
layers.gap_plan: Build: complete one video → SLAM → USD pipeline with residual report. Deploy: use the map for a real manipulation trial.

layers.one_en: World models, VLA, task planning, RSI
layers.gap_plan: Build: reproduce one VLA inference/post-training loop end to end. Deploy: put a policy on hardware under a controlled protocol.

layers.one_zh: 采集、标注、合成数据、SFT/RL/后训练
layers.gap_plan: Build: run a full post-training job with an ablation and a data-contract check.

layers.one_en: Scenes, rendering fidelity, physics, protocols, benchmarks
layers.one_zh: 场景、渲染保真、物理、协议、基准
layers.gap_plan: Deploy: run the evaluation stack as a service for an external team, not just internally.

layers.one_en: Serving, real-time, safety, field ops, clusters
layers.one_zh: 推理服务、实时性、安全、现场、集群
layers.gap_plan: Eval: define SLOs and failure budgets for the serving stack. Deploy: operate a multi-node run with an on-call checklist.

layers.one_en: Use-case selection, ROI, supply chain, roadmap
layers.gap_plan: Design: publish one ROI model with explicit assumptions. Build: build the cost model as a spreadsheet, not prose. Deploy: attach it to a real pilot decision.
